title: UAV-based pavement distress segmentation via controllable synthetic data augmentation and a lightweight selective fusion network under limited annotations
mechanism: A label generator produces multiclass structural label maps and a fine-tuned ControlNet renders spatially aligned image-mask pairs for training.
adaptation: Label generator = edited train masks (inactive from crack isolation logic, splice/gridline layouts from train statistics); ControlNet fine-tuned on 478 cells, 1-ch replicated; cracks only with ridge-snapped labels. Targets inactive and weak other classes.
min_experiment: PF + 3x synthetic (1,434 cells) vs PF. Metric mIoU_rob and module-grouped CV inactive IoU. Kill: mIoU_rob gain < +0.01 and CV inactive gain < +0.02.
evidence: R: own UAV-Road set, limited labels; mIoU 83.43 without, 87.92 with 3x synthetic augmentation.
